title: Protobuf: Support editions syntax
description:
This supports the new "editions" syntax  that will be used for protobuf definitions going forward. See the [programming guide](https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/editions/) and [spec](https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/edition-2023-spec/). Without this change, any .proto files using the new syntax are seen as syntax errors. The actual edition doesn't matter so I treated it as a string literal. The only other update was for reserved fields, they no longer get wrapped in quotes.

I added a .proto file as a test first, which failed initially. After committing the updates for the syntax, it passed.

+/* Editions: edition = "edition" "=" [ ( "'" decimalLit "'" ) | ( '"' decimalLit '"' ) ] ";"
+Editions are the replacement for syntax going forward and include a few grammar changes. The content should be a decimal wrapped in quotes,
+but we don't care about what it is. We just need to support the syntax generally, so we can use a strLit to simplify things. This also
+leaves things open in case it changes to a strLit in the future. For examples and explanations see: https://protobuf.dev/editions/overview/
+*/
+edition ::= PT_EDITION PT_ASSIGN PT_STRLIT PT_SEMICOLON.
+
